say:1:1041570701:0.text: I never imagined I'd meet an ancestor here of all places. What a curious twist of fate!
say:1:1041570701:0.source_cn: 没想到会在这里见到先祖，真是奇妙的缘分啊！

say:2:1041570702:0.text: If I remember correctly, you're... ah! That's it. Sage Tilaya, yes?
say:2:1041570702:0.source_cn: 要是我没记错的话，你是缇……哦，想起来了，缇洛亚贤者，对吧？

say:3:1041570703:0.text: W-wait! Me? An... ancestor? You've got the wrong person!
say:3:1041570703:0.source_cn: 等等！我……？先祖？！你、你认错人了吧！

say:4:1041570704:0.text: Oh no, no. I'm not that old yet! I know my eyes still work just fine!
say:4:1041570704:0.source_cn: 不不不，我还没到老眼昏花的年纪，不会认错人！

say:5:1041570705:0.text: You do look much younger than in the historical scrolls, but I recognized you instantly, especially those lovely antlers of yours.
say:5:1041570705:0.source_cn: 虽然你看上去比记史卷轴绘制的模样年轻不少，但我一眼就能...

say:6:1041570706:0.source_cn: 哇哦……真是出乎意料的情况……

say:7:1041570707:0.text: Well... um, thank you? Yours look wonderfully cared for too.
say:7:1041570707:0.source_cn: 总之……呃，谢谢你的夸奖？你的鹿角保养得也很不错。

say:8:1041570708:0.text: Hehe, that's all thanks to that boy Damian.
say:8:1041570708:0.source_cn: 呵呵，这都是多亏了达米安那小子。

say:9:1041570709:0.text: He's brewed several antler-nourishing tonics. Most of them work... more or less.
say:9:1041570709:0.source_cn: 他研制了好几种鹿角滋养液，大部分的功效都还算说得过去。

say:10:1041570710:0.text: There's one in particular that gives off a strange scent. It's supposed to repel the bugs drawn to the fresh shoots that sprout on our antlers...
say:10:1041570710:0.source_cn: 我记得，其中有一种滋养液会散发奇特的香味，能够驱赶被鹿...

say:11:1041570711:0.text: That actually sounds useful. I'll take some.

say:12:1041570712:0.text: Ever since I moved here, butterflies and bees keep treating my head like a flower field. I can't shoo them away at all!
say:12:1041570712:0.source_cn: 自从移居过来以后，围绕在我头上的蝴蝶和蜜蜂就越来越多，...

say:13:1041570713:0.text: They even flutter around me when I practice my blade. How am I supposed to focus like that?!
say:13:1041570713:0.source_cn: 就连我练习刀法的时候它们都在我身边飞来飞去。害得我挥刀...

say:14:1041570714:0.text: Ah... I'm afraid that won't be easy.

say:15:1041570715:0.text: That tonic has a rather nasty side effect. It makes new shoots grow nonstop, I have to trim them several times a day.
say:15:1041570715:0.source_cn: 这种滋养液的副作用有点严重，会让双角源源不断地萌发新芽...

say:16:1041570716:0.text: I used it once before bed, and when I woke up the next morning, the leaves had grown right in front of my eyes!
say:16:1041570716:0.source_cn: 前一天晚上睡觉前用，第二天睡醒的时候，角上的树叶都长到...

say:17:1041570717:0.text: Hmph! That rascal never thinks about side effects when he invents things. He gave me no end of trouble!
say:17:1041570717:0.source_cn: 哼，达米安那臭小子，每次搞发明都不注意有什么副作用，可...

say:19:1041570719:0.text: Oh, I made sure to give him a proper scolding with my cane umbrella!
say:19:1041570719:0.source_cn: 为了这事，我可是拿伞杖好好教训了他一顿！

say:20:1041570720:0.text: You scolded a child that young? Isn't that a bit much?
say:20:1041570720:0.source_cn: 教训那么小的孩子？这不太好吧？

say:21:1041570721:0.text: It's only right! Sage Tilaya, didn't you keep your little brother in line the same way?
say:21:1041570721:0.source_cn: 就该这样！缇洛亚贤者，你不也是这样教训你弟弟的吗？

say:23:1041570723:0.text: That's what the historical records say. Because of that, people are always telling me I've got your spirit! (Chuckle)
say:23:1041570723:0.source_cn: 记史卷轴上是这么记载的。就是因为这样，我一直被别人称赞...

say:24:1041570724:0.text: Oh no... what kind of image did I leave behind for future generations?!
say:24:1041570724:0.source_cn: 天哪……我究竟给后世留下了什么形象啊！！
